content: Silence is the safest garment you can wear when walking through the territory of fools.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Solon of Athens & Seven Sages Lore
explanation: Entering into an argument with an irrational, bad-faith person is like wrestling a pig in the mud: after an hour, you are filthy, exhausted, and the pig enjoyed it. Wear the clean cloak of silence and walk past without breaking your stride.
practicalInsight: Do not respond to a provocative or hostile comment online or in conversation today. Let silence be your armor.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you allow foolish, provocative people to bait you into wasting your peace and dignity?
